# Mosaic

> Mosaic turns a screenshot of a web page into its Open Graph image. Add your website's hostname in the dashboard, then point the page's `og:image` meta tag at `https://mosaic.praveenjuge.com/use?url=<URL-encoded page URL>`.

How it works:

- The first request for a page screenshots it, stores the image, and returns a 307 redirect to it. Later requests redirect to the cached image, and images regenerate automatically after 30 days.
- Only hostnames added in the dashboard work, matched exactly (`www.example.com` and `example.com` are different). Other hostnames get a 404 error.
- If a screenshot fails or a limit is reached, Mosaic redirects to the previous image or a placeholder.
- Mosaic is not an image editor or a general-purpose screenshot API.

## Docs

- [Add Your Website to Mosaic](https://mosaic.praveenjuge.com/help/add-your-website-to-mosaic): Add your site in the dashboard and copy its OG image link.
- [Use the Mosaic API](https://mosaic.praveenjuge.com/help/use-the-mosaic-api): The `/use` endpoint and its responses.
- [Understanding Usage Limits](https://mosaic.praveenjuge.com/help/understanding-usage-limits): Daily screenshot limits and what happens when one is reached.
- [How Mosaic Refreshes OG Images](https://mosaic.praveenjuge.com/help/refresh-og-images-for-a-website): Automatic 30-day refresh.
- [Delete a Website from Mosaic](https://mosaic.praveenjuge.com/help/delete-a-website-from-mosaic): Remove a website and what happens to its images.
- [Help center](https://mosaic.praveenjuge.com/help): All help articles and guides.
